messages.subject: ggplot2 package error
parts:
Hello Everyone,

However, when I try to load the ggplot2 package, I get the following error:

Loading required package: reshape

messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 package error

That's not an error, just a warning, and will be fixed in the next
version. The package will work fine regardless.

Hadley
